# Question: How many people were experiencing homelessness in the county this winter? Cite sources.

## Answer
The county counted 2,140 people experiencing homelessness in January 2026 [S1]. The count recorded 610 people in emergency shelters [S1].

## Evidence
- 35 percent of unsheltered people had been homeless for more than a year [S2].
- A preliminary count found 2,140 people experiencing homelessness [S1].
- The analysis interviewed 220 people at outreach sites [S2].

## Counter-evidence and limits
- Final figures are due in May [S1].

## Next actions
- Recheck the total when the final May figures are published (judgment)

## Sources
- [S1] County point-in-time count summary
- [S2] Nonprofit unsheltered population analysis
